svg.title: D6 ingredient inclusion: held-out ranking and uncertainty
svg.desc: Every label is shown by validation prevalence and median AP across five late checkpoints, with nominal 95% image-cluster bootstrap intervals. Colors reproduce the complete inclusion decision.

g.text: Validation AP at epochs 32, 34, 36, 38 and 40; Q is their median.

g.text: Sensitivity does not choose the floor.
Vertical bars: nominal 95% paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals for Q.
Colors also require paired Q − prevalence and IQR gates; plot coordinates alone do not determine eligibility.
Exploratory post-P4 amendment · no test results · eligibility evidence, not the final P6 vocabulary.
